function show(operation:(r:RegExp)=>unknown,flags:string){
 const r=new RegExp("(y)",flags);Object.freeze(r);
 try{operation(r);}catch{console.log("caught",flags);}
}
show(r=>r.exec("y"),"g");
show(r=>r.test("y"),"g");
show(r=>r.exec("y"),"y");
show(r=>r.test("y"),"y");
show(r=>r.exec("no"),"g");
show(r=>"y".match(r),"g");
show(r=>"y".replace(r,"z"),"g");
show(r=>"y".replace(r,"z"),"y");
show(r=>"y".replaceAll(r,"z"),"g");
const plain=/(y)/;Object.freeze(plain);console.log(plain.exec("y")![1]);
